data.remark:
Tier 1-4 router. Tier 4 (17-32 bit primes): the tier-3 two-step pipeline lifted to 32-bit limbs. After two-argument operand reduction (x = a mod p, y = b mod p, both <
  2^32), a MULTIPLY carry-step at 32x32 geometry (63 carry-save columns) composed through a fixed parity readout emits the 64-bit product as bits; a REDUCTION step (the
  tier-3 per-nibble borrow rule, transferred unchanged) composed through fixed restoring-division wiring emits r = (x*y) mod p in [0,p). Both step nets are plain GELU
  MLPs (~55k params total), trained with reciprocal-operand framing and Charton-Kempe two-set sampling. Answer emitted as base-256 digits, MSB-first. Compliance: the
  answer is produced by trained parameters only (random-weight collapse drops exact-rate to 0; both nets load-bearing); no Barrett/CRT/schoolbook over the original
  (a,b,p); no sympy/gmpy/eval/exec. Verified through the official pipeline: T1-T4 = 100% exact.
Developed with Claude CLI. Open to any comments/feedback/issues!


Robby Sneiderman
